title: VK-only Write Multiple Coils
purpose: Exercise variable-length coil data, quantity-to-byte-count interaction, and server reply construction using a small valid payload.

messages.label: write eight coils with one data byte

expected_behavior: The server should consume the complete request, apply or reject the eight-coil write, and produce a fixed response containing the starting address and quantity.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0008 equals unit identifier plus the seven-byte PDU.
Function code 0f has quantity 8 and byte count 1, with matching data length.
issue_safety_notes: This explores the issue-related variable-length write and reply structure but uses independently chosen address, transaction, and data values. It does not copy historical crash payloads or assert that the reported memory fault is reproduced.
